patch_description: This version allocates neighborhood trials using observed improvement rates: successful move types receive more trials, while every type retains a minimum share for exploration. It combines bottleneck-focused two-switches, three-link rotations and multi-switch kicks, ranks proposals using both surrogate energy and dual prices, and diversifies the initial and ongoing search archives. LP calls are spent only on fresh, valid networks, with a small batch size to keep feedback adaptive and runtime within the limit.
